7	# Orcha Agents — Upstream Version Upgrade

11	## Pre-Flight Checks

16	2. **Check current version**: `grep '"version"' package.json` and compare with latest upstream tag.

20	## Step 1: Rebase Fork Commits

156	| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
157	|---------|-------|-----|
158	| `MenuPortal must be used within Menu` | Duplicate `@radix-ui/react-context` versions | Pin via `pnpm.overrides` |
159	| `Claude Code SDK not found` | SDK not copied to app bundle | Fix `extraResources` from-path in `electron-builder.yml` |

163	| Sentry errors in console | Sentry enabled in fork | `Sentry.init({ enabled: false })` in main, removed from renderer |

168	| "Craft Agent" (singular) in UI | Only "Craft Agents" (plural) was replaced in first pass | Grep for both forms, replace all |
169	| `Network interceptor not found` | Interceptor path not resolved after rebase (upstream path changes) | Since `aad9907` only a warning, not fatal — sessions work without tool metadata. Verify `interceptor.cjs` in build |
170	| Session stuck on "queued" after auth error | `getOrCreateAgent()` throws, `onProcessingStopped()` never called, `isProcessing` stays true | Fixed in `aad9907`: try-catch around agent init + 5-min watchdog. Preserve these changes during rebase |

188	Bei einem neuen Upstream-Release:
189	
190	```bash
191	# 1. Upstream-Änderungen holen

195	git diff --name-only HEAD..upstream/main

198	# Alle Branches die auf altem Upstream basieren updaten:
199	git checkout main
200	git rebase upstream/main
201	# → Konflikte in den Berührungspunkten (s.o.) manuell lösen
